description: This file defines the class 'searchCommands' which contains methods for managing and executing search operations related to test cases, test suites, requirements, and other entities within the TestLink project. It includes initialization, environment setup, and various search functions with filtering capabilities.

classes.name: searchCommands
classes.description: A class providing search functionalities for test cases, test suites, requirements, and related entities in the TestLink system, with methods for initializing environment, schema, and executing filtered searches.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing database connection and setting up configuration, including database type-specific operators.

methods.name: isReqFeatureEnabled
methods.description: Checks if requirement feature is enabled for a given test project.

methods.name: getTestCaseIDSet
methods.description: Retrieves all test case IDs for a specific test project.

methods.name: getTestSuiteIDSet
methods.description: Retrieves test suite IDs for a test project, excluding certain node types.

methods.name: getReqSpecIDSet
methods.description: Retrieves requirement specification IDs for a test project.

methods.name: getReqIDSet
methods.description: Retrieves requirement IDs for a test project.

methods.name: getArgs
methods.description: Returns the current arguments object.

methods.name: getGui
methods.description: Returns the GUI object.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Returns the current filters.

methods.name: getTables
methods.description: Returns the database tables used.

methods.name: getViews
methods.description: Returns the database views used.

methods.name: initEnv
methods.description: Initializes environment by setting up arguments, GUI, and search parameters.

methods.name: initSchema
methods.description: Initializes database tables and views used for searches.

methods.name: initArgs
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes input arguments, including date conversions and user permissions.

methods.name: initGui
methods.description: Sets up GUI object with default and current search parameters.

methods.name: initSearch
methods.description: Prepares search filters, including requirement feature enablement, custom fields, keywords, and target settings.

methods.name: searchReqSpec
methods.description: Searches requirement specifications based on target set and filters.

methods.name: searchReq
methods.description: Searches requirements with filtering by scope, status, type, and custom fields.

methods.name: searchTestSuites
methods.description: Searches test suites based on target set and title/summary filters.

methods.name: searchTestCases
methods.description: Searches test cases with filters for steps, expected results, status, keywords, custom fields, and target set.

methods.name: getTestCaseWKFStatusDomain
methods.description: Returns the domain mapping for test case workflow statuses.
